description: Async undo and redo stack for a single document editor instance.

members.name: BeginBatch
members.description: Begins collecting commands into one undoable batch.

members.name: ClearAsync
members.description: Clears all undo and redo state.

members.name: CommitBatch
members.description: Commits the open batch as one undo step.

members.name: PushAsync
members.description: Executes a command and records it as an undo step.

members.name: RedoAsync
members.description: Redoes the last undone command when available.

members.name: RollbackBatchAsync
members.description: Rolls back and discards the open batch.

members.name: UndoAsync
members.description: Undoes the last command when available.
